name: Chest freezer

comps.spec: Hermetic refrigeration compressor, about 1/6–1/4 hp, in a sealed system: keep the whole freezer running rather than opening it
Thick polyurethane foam walls, about 5–8 cm, bonded to the cabinet; the Frigidaire lids are insulated with bulk fibreglass
The cabinet itself: a superinsulated box that holds cold for a day or more with the power off
Run capacitor, 6–15 µF at 220–250V (Danby 6 or 8 µF 250V, Frigidaire 12 or 15 µF 220V) — discharge it through a resistor tool before touching it; keep it with its compressor
Compressor start relay or PTC starter (Danby QP2-4.7H, JPQII-4.7 or QP2-4R7), or a single compressor controller on the Frigidaire models — the compressor won't start without its own
Compressor overload protector (Danby DRB21R61A1, BT62-120 or DRB18R61A1); a continuity reading doesn't prove it will still trip, so never heat or bridge a salvaged one

notes: The most power-efficient fridge there is: run as a fridge on an external thermostat it uses a fraction of an upright fridge’s energy, because cold air stays in when the lid opens.
